mechanism_claims.claim_text: BiF2_5K7K inhibits biofilm formation with support from biofilm matrix staining and transcriptional changes in polysaccharide-production and quorum-sensing genes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is specific to the assayed S. epidermidis biofilm context and does not establish a universal antimicrobial mechanism for all targets.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Circular dichroism supports an amphipathic alpha-helical conformation under membrane-mimicking conditions, which is mechanistic context rather than standalone proof of membrane disruption.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane permeabilization or membrane-potential assay was recovered locally.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BiF2_5K7K against preformed Staphylococcus epidermidis biofilm
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Mature-biofilm eradication is supported by MBEC values, confocal biofilm-matrix reduction, and live/dead staining, but remains phenotype-supported for biofilm damage rather than a fully closed molecular target.
